title: International Trigonometry Challenge
text:
Are you someone who loves Mathematics alot, especially Geometry & Trigonometry ? If yes, the ITC is for you. ITC is an online international trigonometry championship being conducted by a group of Mathematics Enthusiasts. The purpose of ITC is to help the participants realize the beauty of trigonometry, feel the concepts and learn how to apply them. ITC focuses not on just the problems related to triangles on paper but on the application of trigonometry to solve real life problems.

For more info, visit https://itc2020.wordpress.com
